title: Too easy divisors
statement: What is the total number of factors of $12$, including $1$ and $12$ themselves?
hints: Use divisor pairing: each divisor $d$ goes with $12/d$.
solution: The divisors are $1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12$, so there are $6$. Why this works. divisor-pairing: each divisor pairs with its partner, so few checks are needed.
check_program: print(sum(1 for d in range(1, 13) if 12 % d == 0))
